items.text: The design does not define the retry budget, backoff limits, or automatic-processing stop condition for ambiguous provider responses.
The warm standby design has neither a scheduled exercise nor a measured recovery result.
The proposed 30-day routing-record retention period has not received formal governance confirmation.
Document retry and backoff controls; Riley Chen agreed to complete this by 2026-09-18.
Schedule and document the regional failover exercise; Avery Patel agreed to complete this by 2026-09-21.
Approved numeric alert thresholds and an evidence-backed on-call response target are not available yet.
The runbook does not identify the production support escalation roster or approved after-hours handoff.
